credits.note: The Credits page. The cards are set in a serif font that has no straight apostrophe and no slash: use the curly apostrophe (’) and write around slashes. The photographers themselves come from image-credits.json.

lost.note: The page shown for an address that leads nowhere (src/content/404.njk). Its giant name is the title at the top of that file; it is set in the headline font, which has letters, digits, the comma, the hyphen and the full stop only. The card below is set in the serif font: use the curly apostrophe (’) and no slashes. The descriptions beside Projects and About come from navigation.json.
lost.title: Off the chart
paragraphs: This page isn’t on any chart I have. It moved, sank, or never existed.
I’d blame the tide, but it was probably me.
